candidates.description: Join us for stories, music, movement and more at our preschool storytime in the Orchard Room on Thursday afternoons at 3:30 p.m. For accessibility accommodations (ex. ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
candidates.tips: Preschool storytime is suitable for children 3-5 and their caregivers.

candidates.title: Baby Storytime: Rerun
candidates.description:
Did you miss Wednesday's Baby Storytime? Come on Friday! We'll redo our musical storytime for infants, babies, and new toddlers with a brief Stay & Play for grownups to connect and mingle. This program is designed for ages 0-18 months.

 Assisted Listening Devices available upon request.

candidates.title: LEGO Fridays!
candidates.audiences: Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs)
candidates.description: We have the LEGOs! Bring your imagination and build something fun! In addition to being a great way to introduce the engineering and art concepts of STEAM, playing with LEGO’s supports early childhood development because children engage in problem solving, teamwork, self-confidence, and creativity!
candidates.tips: LEGOs will stay at the library, so be sure to snap a pic of your creation!

candidates.title: Chill Out with Mindfulness Meditation
candidates.audiences: Adults; Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Seniors; Teens (14-18); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs); Tweens (11-13)
candidates.description: Center yourself and increase your focus with mindfulness meditation led by Phuong Pham. Each session begins with an introduction to meditation, 15 minutes of sitting and releasing meditation, and group sharing and Q&A. This program is open to all ages, young and old, and all levels of experience. Chairs are available for adults who do not bring them. Phuong is a Buddhist nun experienced in leading mindfulness meditation. You can learn more about Phuong here and can watch her meditation videos on
candidates.tips:
Children under 10 years old must be accompanied by an adult.
No registration is required.
Participants are encouraged to bring their own yoga mats and/or meditation cushions.

candidates.title: Bob Baker Marionette Theater Variety Show
candidates.audiences: Adults; Teens; Seniors; Babies; Preschoolers; All Ages; Tweens; Children; Families; Toddlers
candidates.description: Bob Baker Marionette Theater is bringing the puppet magic to the Mountain View Public Library. This variety show will be roughly 30 minutes long and feature between 12 and 25 puppets from their iconic collection! After the show, there will be a quick 15 minute Q&A. This magical show will take place in Pioneer Park. Feel free to bring a fold-out chair, towel, or blanket for your comfort out in the park. This type of fun has no age limit! This event is generously sponsored by the Friends of the Mo
candidates.tips:
Registration is recommended.
Walk-ins are also welcome.

candidates.title: Smart Start Babytime
candidates.description: Smart Start Babytime is a special program for babies (0–2) and their caregivers that blends stories, songs, and early play with different information each week with a pediatric resident from Stanford Medical School. Caregivers will gain practical tips, build confidence, and have the opportunity to ask questions—all in a warm, supportive environment designed for your baby’s earliest learning.

candidates.title: Family Storytime
candidates.audiences: Babies (under 2); Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs)
candidates.description: Join Librarian Jennifer (and Rocky Raccoon) on Tuesdays at 10:30 AM for Family Storytime at Children's Library! Come sing, rhyme, and read stories with us! While this storytime will be geared towards those older than 2 years, all ages are welcome! Storytime will be held inside when the garden is unavailable. Make sure to follow us on YouTube for more stories, songs and rhymes, including a playlist of all of our favorite songs to sing!
candidates.tips:
Please note that this storytime is an indoor/outdoor program.
Access to the Secret Garden outside is weather dependent.

candidates.title: Outdoor Storytime
candidates.description: Tuesdays at 10:30 a.m. All events are weather permitting.
candidates.tips:
Bring a blanket and enjoy stories, songs, and rhymes with our Children's Librarians in Pioneer Park.
All ages welcome, no registration required.

candidates.title: Little Ones Storytime
candidates.description: Join Librarian Heidi on Wednesday mornings at 10:30AM for Little Ones Storytime at Children's Library. Storytime includes a variety of early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, and movement activities. Storytime is a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of reading and learning for all ages.

candidates.title: Music & Movement
candidates.audiences: Babies (under 2); Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs)
candidates.description:
Bring your dancing feet to the Mitchell Park Library on Wednesday evenings for Music & Movement with Librarian Celina. Build early literacy skills through movement, songs, and dance.

 Instruments, songs, and dance moves will all be introduced so that everyone will be able to enjoy moving along to the music.

 This program is meant for families with children and no previous experience is needed!
